descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S21 「Copy Assessment & Plan only：记录格式 × 剪贴板上拿到什么」 Copy Assessment & Plan only: note format × what lands on the clipboard

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 'Copy Assessment & Plan only' copies just the A&P section to the clipboard.（UAT TC-17；TFA-92595 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Six charts with generated notes in different formats, both contexts

When Tap 'Copy Assessment & Plan only' on each and read the clipboard

Then Single 'ASSESSMENT AND PLAN' heading → that section to its end, no SUBJECTIVE/OBJECTIVE text; separate ASSESSMENT + PLAN headings → both, nothing above; appended ADDENDUM → A&P without the addendum (Q1); Discharge summary → its A&P part, no discharge instructions (Q1); SNF follow-up note N-N → ASSESSMENT + PLAN; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Clipboard text per row: mustContain the A&P sentences, mustNotContain the SUBJECTIVE/OBJECTIVE sentences and (per Q1) the addendum and discharge instructions. The button is not built on main (known: TFA-92595 AC 4), so the scenario is blocked until it exists

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-17.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。
